regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing but not one-narrative regime: AI Infrastructure leads on rank (1.56) with only 12.5% breadth and murky 'mixed' trend-health, while US Energy Complex sits close behind (1.375, 64% breadth) as the coherent challenger. 45% of themes are trend-gate-eligible, gate_helps is true, so the regime is an intact-but-fading AI-led tape with an energy counter-trend — not a decisive handoff. Directional accuracy on past calls is only 0.46, so every lean below is deliberately low-conviction and conditional.
emerging_watch: Watching whether US Energy Complex completes a confirmed handoff from AI Infrastructure: the observable would be AI Infra (SMH) losing gate eligibility while Energy breadth stays above 0.6 and the rotation margin widens past 0.4 — that would retire the 'no handoff' read.

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Energy is the most coherent trend-gate-eligible theme by breadth (0.636) with a durability bar above 0.5 ('mixed' trend tag but improving cohesion), and it is the verified challenger to a leader whose breadth has collapsed to 0.125. The rotation margin (0.185) is thin and 'directional: false', so this is NOT a handoff call — only a lean toward the theme with better internal trend cohesion while it remains gate-eligible.
evidence: breadth 0.636 — highest among eligible non-defensive themes
theses.dissent: Energy leadership may just be a mean-reversion bounce off a weak AI tape; the absolute-trend gate shows no return edge on this market, only drawdown control, so overweighting on momentum logic carries no positive-return prior.

falsifier.text: XLE breaks below its own trend-gate eligibility (durability_bar drops under 0.5) or lags SPY by more than 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity ranks 3 and is gate-eligible with a genuine 'trend' tag, but it is the only prominent theme flagged crowded (z 1.61). Per guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution, never a fade — so the honest lean is 'avoid adding' rather than underweight. The theme's own breadth (0.60) is healthy, so this is purely a crowding texture caution, not a bearish read.
evidence: crowded true (z 1.61) — only top-tier theme with the flag
guardrails: crowding only DOWN-SIZES, never sells
theses.dissent: Crowding has no basket-level forward edge; reflexive crowding can persist for months, and refusing exposure to a genuinely trending theme can underperform.

falsifier.text: CIBR crowding_z falls back under 1.0 while keeping its trend-gate eligibility before the check-by date

theses.subject: Managed Care & Insurers
theses.thesis: This theme has the highest durability_bar (0.81) and strongest breadth (0.778) in the entire rank list, yet its momentum score is essentially flat (-0.08) and it remains gate-eligible — a late-cycle defensive that is technically in an uptrend but not leading. It is also crowded (z 1.11). There is no positive momentum leg to lean on, so the call is to avoid adding despite excellent trend health.
evidence: durability_bar 0.81, breadth 0.778 — strongest in the list
theses.dissent: If the AI/energy tape rolls over, this is exactly the defensive, high-breadth trend that could attract risk-off rotation despite its low momentum score.

falsifier.text: XLV (proxy) gains more than 5% relative to SPY while staying gate-eligible before the check-by date
